articleTitle: Accurate Real-time Ship Target detection Using Yolov4
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, surface ships have been developing toward intelligence and autonomy. Fast and accurate ship target detection is an important source of visual perception information of intelligent ship. In this paper, a fast and accurate ship target detection algorithm based on YOLOv4 is proposed for the problems of low accuracy and poor real-time performance of existing ship detection algorithms. YOLOv4 is currently one of the fastest and most accurate target detection algorithms with a wide range of applications in various fields. For ship targets, in order to achieve better detection results, some methods are used to improve the algorithm, such as K-means clustering, model structure modification and Mixup. In order to verify the effectiveness of the method, a ship target detection dataset is constructed by collecting various ship targets. And the training and tests of the algorithm model are completed in a GPU cloud server. The performance of the algorithm is compared to that of Faster R-CNN, SSD and YOLOv3 through experiments. The results show that this method has satisfactory accuracy and real-time detection of ship targets.

articleTitle: Ensuring Absolute Transit Priority Through Trajectory Based Control of Connected and Automated Traffic
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: This paper proposes a Trajectory Based Control (TBC) method for connected automated traffic. The goal is to ensure absolute transit priority without heavy sacrifices from the general traffic. To achieve the goal, a Bus Priority Lane (BPL) is designed. The BPL is open for general traffic if needed. To implement the BPL, the proposed TBC controller would control whether and how general traffic accesses the BPL so that the sacrifice of general traffic is minimized. The proposed TBC controller is evaluated through comparison against the non-control baseline that ensures absolute transit priority with a Dedicated Bus Lane (DBL). Sensitivity analysis is conducted under different congestion levels. The results demonstrate that the proposed TBC controller outperforms the non-control baseline in terms of throughput benefits.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Isolated Lane Layout in Automated Container Terminal Yard
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Aiming at an automated container terminal whose blocks in yard are parallel to the quay shoreline, this paper designs an isolated lane layout of the yard, which physically separates the ARTs (Artificial Robot Intelligence of Transportation) from the external trucks while driving. ART travels counterclockwise along its driving lane, and the external truck drives clockwise along its driving lane, so that the two vehicles no longer share the same lane. Therefore, isolated lane layout can improve the efficiency of transportation. Finally, we build the simulation model of the isolated lane layout in automated container terminal yard through AnyLogic software. The performance of the isolated lane layout and the traditional automated container terminal layout which blocks are vertical to the quay shoreline is evaluated. Compared with the vertical layout, the simulation results show that under the isolated lane layout, the average waiting time of the ARTs and the external trucks could be reduced by 85% and 75%, the average queue length is reduced by 80% and 41%, and the operation efficiency of the yard is improved by 4%.

articleTitle: Fast Braking Control of Ship Hybrid Propulsion System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Ship hybrid propulsion system has been more and more popular in small-to-middle sized riverboats, ‘river and sea’ boats and coaster crafts, because of its high flexibility and efficiency. However, this hybrid power ship normally needs to reverse the main engine to asternway, in the braking period the main engine will even stop inj ection so as to shut its output torque off, which extends the braking time. In view of this phenomenon, this paper analyses the torque characteristics of propeller in the braking period by simulation. On the basis of propeller torque characteristics study, a MTPA(maximum torque per ampere) control method of shaft motor and the supercapacitor reserving mode is proposed to absorb braking energy, thus reducing braking time.

articleTitle: Testing and Evaluation of Autonomous Vehicles Based on Safety of the Intended Functionality
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Testing and evaluation are essential for the development and deployment of Autonomous Vehicles (AVs). In this paper, a testing and evaluation procedure for AVs is proposed, which is deliberately designed based on Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF). This procedure combines the benefits of both simulation tests and on-road tests. The goal is to present a testing and evaluation procedure that takes the minimum effort while produces results with sufficient confidence.

articleTitle: Fire Risk Assessment of Battery Ship Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Recently, there has been a significant increase in interest in battery-powered vehicles to reduce emissions according to stringent regulations. Battery-powered ships pose a huge risk of fire. The consequences are dangerous. The main purpose of this paper is to determine the degree of risk of fire on a battery-powered ship and thereby improve the safety of battery-powered ships. Determining the causes of a fire on a battery ship is paramount. Even the smallest events can cause serious accidents. The study examined all the main causes of fire in a battery-powered vessel from the perspective of equipment failure, human factors, electrical faults and failure in a ship battery compartment, built the fire risk assessment model for battery ship based on Bayesian network. The prior probability and conditional probability tables of the model were generated using statistical data and expert judgment. A 500-ton pure electric cargo ship in Huzhou, China, was selected as an example for this assessment. The results show that the probability of a fire on a battery-powered ship is less than 5%. Moreover, measures have been proposed to reduce the occurrence of malfunctions leading to an explosion or fire.

articleTitle: Research on pollution prevention and control of tank washing water
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: During tank washing operation of cargo exchange, repair or dry-docking and other reasons, water containing liquid bulk cargo residues will be produced. Since most of the tank washing water is toxic and harmful, once it discharged to water without receiving and disposing, it will cause serious pollution to coastal waters and river water environment. This paper studied the production, receiving and disposal of tank washing water for liquid bulk carriers. According to relevant environmental laws and regulations, policies and specifications, management mechanism, construction of environmental protection facilities, key technology for disposal, tracking supervision and other main problems. Then we put forward corresponding management countermeasures and suggestions. The results are of great significance for the water pollution prevention and control improvement, the promotion of green development of water transport industry, and coastal and inland water environment protection in China.

articleTitle: Inflatable Slide-type Marine Rescue and Evacuation System Based on Beam-truss Structures
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: The SOLAS Convention stipulates that large passenger ships must be equipped with life support equipment. The marine evacuation system has better characteristics than traditional ways, which takes up less deck space and higher evacuation efficiency. It is the main research direction of life support equipment for passenger ships. This paper proposes an inflatable slide-type marine evacuation system based on beam-truss structures. A constitutive model is established based on the characteristics of TPU materials to predict the mechanical properties of the inflatable structure. According to the sealing and load bearing requirements of structural parts, the manufacturing process is established; Based on the truss theory, the influence of internal pressure of airbag, the length of the whole slide and the side length of slide section on the structural stiffness of the slide is analyzed; The results show that the evacuation system has high reliability and safety, and the actual evacuation efficiency can reach 524 people / 30 minutes.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Model for Maritime Accident Analysis by Using Functional Resonance Analysis Method (FRAM)
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: With the melting of sea ice, the Arctic region attracts a large number of tourists due to its unique geographical location and abundant tourism resources. The ship tourism business scale in the Arctic region continues to expand. However, there are more ship incidents/accidents in Arctic waters with the increase of ship activities. There is a requirement to make the safety management of passenger ships in Arctic operations. This paper focuses on the accident scenario analysis in Arctic shipping. The functional resonance analysis method (FRAM) systematically analyzes ship scenario accidents in Arctic waters by transforming accident-related events into interrelated functional modules and studying the mechanism of accidents from the perspective of functional characteristics. The “Clipper Adventurer” ship grounding accident is chosen as a case to explore system functions, variability, and complex interactions in Arctic shipping.

articleTitle: Research on Port Shore Power Advance Path Under the Background of Carbon Neutral in China
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: China's carbon emission peaking and carbon neutral strategy has become a national strategy. Port is the key unit of carbon emission, the carbon emission of berthing ships accounts for more than 60% of the total carbon emission of the port, therefore, it is very important to promote the use of shore power by ships to reach the carbon emission peaking of port. This paper aims at the problems of low utilization rate of shore power, small number of ship shore power facilities and low willingness of ship to connect port shore power. Through the scenario analysis method, the problems of shore power utilization economy were deeply analyzed, and through investigation and comparative analysis, the shore power propulsion path of the port was studied. The following measures were put forward: 1. Increase the proportion of state capital award for ship shore power facilities;2. Pilot project of compulsory use of shore power in key areas;3. Promoting the use of port low voltage shore power;4. Give full play to the supervision and management role of local government in the construction and use of shore power. This paper provides technical support for improving the utilization rate of port and ship shore power, these measures will greatly reduce the carbon emissions of ships in the port area, and contribute to China's carbon emission peaking in 2030 and carbon neutral in 2060.

articleTitle: Effect of soaking time on tribological Properties of Thordon bearing Materials in High Temperature Water Bath
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In view of the fact that its tribological performance will be changed by the Thordon bearing being soaked in the high temperature water environment when working. Thordon bearing samples was soaked in high temperature water bath at 80°C for 0h, 24h, 48h and 72h to study the effect of soaking time on the tribological properties of water lubrication of Thordon. The ring - block friction and wear tests were carried out by SSB-100V ship stern bearing testing machine. The results showed that under the same load and rotational speed, the friction coefficient of Thordon decreased at first and then increased from the increase in soaking time, and the friction coefficient was the minimum when soaked for 24 hours. The main wear mechanism of Thordon material is adhesive wear and furrow wear. With the increase in soaking time, the wear volume of Thordon decreased at first and then increased, and the wear volume was the minimum when the soaking time was 24 hours. This indicates that the soaking time will have an impact on the wear volume of Thordon material.

articleTitle: Research status and prospect of LNG inland waterway transportation safety in China
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In order to help relevant researchers understand the current situation and development trend of inland LNG transportation in China, this paper reviews the development of two main modes of domestic LNG water transportation, packaging transportation and bulk transportation, and introduces the research progress and safety research results of LNG ship safety and LNG tank transportation pilot work with reference to relevant literature. The research results show that the demand for LNG is increasing day by day, In the future, a variety of inland LNG transportation chains will coexist, mainly LNG storage tank transportation, supplemented by small and medium-sized LNG carriers.

articleTitle: Obstacle recognition method for ship based on 3D lidar
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent ships, the perception of the navigation environment, which is the basis of intelligent navigation, has attracted more and more attention. At the same time, the lidar with high-ranking accuracy and strong anti-interference ability has also received more attention in the ship perception field. Aiming at the automatic detection and identification of typical obstacles for intelligent ships during navigation, an algorithm is proposed for the obstacle recognition of waterways based on 3D lidar. At first, the original point cloud obtained by 3D lidar is preprocessed to filter out noise signals. Then, the water surface and the waterway line are segmented by analyzing the point cloud features. Finally, a new DBSCAN clustering model is proposed and the obstacle features are summarized to complete the classification. A series of field experiments have been carried out. The experimental results show that the algorithm performs high accuracy and reliability for obstacle recognition.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of ship collision in cross-channel based on Monte Carlo method
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Cross-channel is common in the sea and inland rivers. Although there are more detailed navigation rules, the accidents of ships collision in the cross-channel waters are still increasing year by year. In order to ensure the safe navigation of ships in the cross-channel, it is necessary to establish the calculation model of ship collision risk in the cross-channel and evaluate its collision risk. This paper draws on the Event collision risk assessment model in aviation and forms an applicable ship domain model according to the characteristics of ship navigation. Monte Carlo method and Matlab software are used to study the risks of ships passing at the intersection of waterways, and specific countermeasures to control the navigation safety of the cross waterways are put forward.

articleTitle: An overview of robust maritime situation awareness methods
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Maritime situation awareness is the core of ship navigation and determines the development direction of smart ships. Visual perception becomes an active yet important research task in maritime traffic. To aim that, this paper introduces three situation awareness methods based on visual images. The first method uses kernelized correlation filtering algorithms and Kalman filter models to solve ship occlusion in the image and achieve accurate ship tracking tasks; The second method uses kernelized correlation filtering and logarithmic polar coordinate transformation to solve the imaging size changes during ship navigation; The third method uses yolo algorithms to obtain the high-quality distance information from port videos. The experimental results and quantitative indicators show that each method can effectively achieve reliable maritime situational awareness tasks. The comprehensive realization of maritime situation awareness can better reduce risks and ensure the safety of ships.

articleTitle: Application of Lion Swarm Optimization in Berth Allocation Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: The construction of an intelligent port can promote the development of intelligent shipping. Berth resources are scarce resources in ports and terminals. For incoming ships, reasonable allocation of berth resources can shorten the ship's port time, speed up the overall operational efficiency of the terminal, and enhance the comprehensive competitiveness of the port. At present, the allocation of berth resources mostly relies on the experience of the port center dispatchers, and there will inevitably that there will be phenomena such as waiting for available berths, waiting for ships, and ship scheduling errors and conflicts. Aiming at the problem of the low efficiency of berth scheduling at the terminal, an optimization model of berth allocation was established. To minimize the total ship in port time, the multi-objective Lion Swarm Optimization algorithm was used to solve the model. Taking the berth allocation problem of a bulk cargo port as an example, the total time of ships in the port after the algorithm optimization is greatly shortened, and a relatively better scheduling plan can be given. A satisfactory application effect can be obtained in the optimization of the ship scheduling, and it can provide the optimization of port berth allocation a new method.

articleTitle: Trajectory Based Active Traffic Management by Leveraging Connected and Automated Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: This paper proposes a Traj ectory based Traffic Management (TTM) decision maker for connected and automated traffic. The goal is to enable active traffic management on a microscopic level with the help of Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs). The proposed decision maker bears the following features: i) enable real-time traffic demand management; ii) ensure control stability; iii) be potential for extension to partially connected and automated traffic. The proposed decision maker is evaluated on a freeway segment. The results demonstrate that the proposed method performs good control stability. It is revealed that the proposed decision maker can stabilize in 2 min.

articleTitle: Layout Optimization of China Railway Express with Multiple Transportation Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: China Railway Express (CR Express) plays an important role in the China international trade logistics system. CR Express has always adopted a point-to-point direct transportation (DT) mode since its first opening in 2011, which contributed to the rapid development of China CR Express networks in the early stage. However, with the reducing of subsidies, the transit transportation (TT) mode appears which performs better with respect to the improvement of efficiency of CR Express transportation networks, and its high-quality and sustainable development. Therefore, a CR Express with mixed transportation modes of both DT and TT modes will be inevitable in the future. This paper proposes a layout optimization model considering both the two transportation modes. It takes the existing cities in CR Express as candidates and allows hub nodes to choose either DT or TT mode. A case study reveals that the DT mode is more suitable for cities with sufficient goods supply, while the TT mode is more suitable for those with insufficient supply of cargo. At the same time, Zhengzhou, Xi'an, Jinan, Urumqi and other cities in key geographical locations are important hub nodes of the network. The proposed layout optimization model of multiple transportation modes not only considers the current conditions of CR Express, but also takes into account the needs of high-quality development in future, which is believed to be able to provide helpful insight into the layout optimization of CR Express transportation networks and its sustainable development.

articleTitle: Research on Methods of Wamings for ADAS Safety Design Method Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Due to the driver failed to detect the vehicle state of risk, the traffic accidents are much higher. The vehicle active safety system can give warnings for driver which may reduce the accident risk. Because of no unified evaluation standard in vehicle warning methods, the drivers were caused the unnecessary trouble. In this paper, the vehicle active safety warnings were designed based on the principle of ergonomics, including the Lane departure warning, collision warning, speeding warning and unsafe driving behavior warning. The Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) was introduced in early warning evaluation model. Finally, subjective and objective quantitative analysis was made to verify the validity of the model, identified that the vehicle active safety warnings is more appropriate for our drivers

articleTitle: Research on Marine VSG Grid-connected Pre-synchronization Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Compared with the land power grid, the capacity of the ship power system is smaller, and the frequent switching and start/stop of high-power converter devices and nonlinear loads will lead to the ship power grid in a non-ideal state with harmonics. At this time, the grid connection of photovoltaic power supply based on Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control technology will lead to poor phase-locking performance and impulse current. However, due to the existence of phase-locked loop (PLL), the speed and accuracy of pre-synchronization of traditional VSG pre-synchronization con-trol strategy are easy to be disturbed when there are a large number of harmonics in ship power grid. In order to solve this problem, an improved pre-synchronization control strategy of marine VSG is proposed in this paper. Two PI regulators are used to replace PLL to reduce control parameters and effectively improve the speed of VSG pre-synchronization. Finally, the effect of this method on improving the grid-connected pow-er quality of marine distributed photovoltaic inverter is verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: A Method for Studying the Influence of Different Berth Layout on Port Service Level Based on Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Berth layout has a significant influence on port service level, in that navigation process in the waterway and handling operation process of ships can be greatly affected under different layout schemes. This study provides a simulation-based method to optimize berth layout, and the developed simulation model includes operation processes of the ship arriving in port, waiting at anchorage, going through the waterway, handling at berth, and leaving the port. Different berth layout schemes in port are input into the simulation models, and results can be obtained by conducting simulation models. It is indicated that the port service level and efficiency will be improved under a reasonable berth layout. This study can provide valuable methods and ideas for port planning and construction.

articleTitle: A Review of Real-Time Energy Consumption and Carbon Dioxide Emission Monitoring System in Ports
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Reducing energy use and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions is now a major policy goal for most ports. Fossil fuel combustion is the main source of GHG emissions. To ingrain decarbonation and energy conservation of ports, the use of innovative technology appears as a critical conduit. In this context, this paper conducts a review of the application of realtime energy consumption monitoring system in ports aiming at pointing out the problems existing in the development of China's ports energy monitoring system. Our systematic review shows that there is a great potential for ports to achieve energy consumption intelligent data analysis, energy use trend prediction and energy saving potential mining analysis. We make suggestions for improvement of real-time monitoring and management system. The establishment of the system can not only improve the accuracy of energy statistics and GHG emission monitoring, but also enhance the digitalization of ports.

articleTitle: Lock Station Allocation in Unlocking and Padlocking Operation of ART in Automated Container Terminal
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the allocation of lock stations in the unlocking operation for ART (Artificial Intelligence Robot of Transportation) in a new type of automated container terminal, this paper proposes two strategies, dynamic allocation and random allocation, to achieve the allocation of ART in lock stations. Combining two strategies with Anylogic simulation software, this paper constructs a simulation model of lock station allocation in ART unlocking operation, and develops three indexes, including the utilization rate of lock station, operation time of ART and waiting time of ART in the pre-parallel buffer (QPB). The simulation results show that the dynamic allocation strategy play the main role in lock stations, reduce the operation time and queuing time of ART, and have a good application value.

articleTitle: The Severity of Maritime Traffic Accidents Prediction Method Based on Bilayer GA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: With the further development of maritime transportation, maritime traffic safety and the consequences of accidents have also been paid more and more attention. In order to improve the predictive accuracy of ranking ship traffic accident and solve the problem of insufficient accuracy in the existing ship accident prediction, this paper studies the idea of multi-layer classification. Based on ship accident data, a two-layer GA-SVM model is designed to achieve accurate classification of ship accident types and levels, also, comparing with other methods. The result shows a good predictive effect, which can provide a decision-making guidance for the safe navigation of ships.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Plate Rubber Shock Absorber Based on ANSYS Workbench
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Plate rubber shock absorbers are widely used in large steel structure environment, especially in bridge and Marine fields. The 2–9 plate rubber shock absorber model are established, and the results of static structure analysis, modal analysis and harmonious response analysis of different plate rubber shock absorbers are obtained, and their static stiffness, dynamic stiffness and natural frequency are obtained. The simulation results of plate rubber damper under the same load are calculated and compared. The results of static analysis show that the stiffness of the shock absorber increases with the increase of the number of layers and the deformation decreases, and the maximum deformation occurs in the middle of the top rubber layer under the same size and stress. The modal analysis results show that the natural frequency of the absorber decreases with the increase of the number of layers. The harmonic response results show that under the same excitation force, the shock absorber becomes more stable with the increase of the number of shock absorber layers. The simulation results are of guiding significance to the practical application of sandwich shock absorber in large mechanical equipment.

articleTitle: Formation controller design for heterogeneous ships based on sliding mode control
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Ship formation control has been widely used in environmental protection and ocean mapping due to its high efficiency. The recent researches on ship formation are mainly aimed at isomorphic types of ships and theoretical simulations. To enhance the feasibility of ship formation for specific scenarios in water, this paper proposes a formation controller based on the leader-follower approach, sliding-mode, and Lyapunov method for heterogeneous ship formation. Finally, the successful implementation of real heterogeneous ship models illustrates the correctness and effectiveness of the formation controller.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis and Countermeasures Study on Major Accidents of Highway and Waterway in China
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In order to delve the rules of major accidents in China's highway and waterway industry, data of sixty-first major accidents occurred since 2013 are used for statistical analysis, in terms of business field, month, place and occurrence time. The analysis shows that the number of major accidents and deaths in China's highway and waterway industry has shown a downward trend. 77% of accidents are road transport accidents; accidents occur frequently in August; at most, 25% of accidents occur during the period from 8:00 to 12:00. Through in-depth analysis of major accidents, key causes of the accidents are illegal behaviors, inadequate safety skills and poor technical conditions of vehicles and vessels. Countermeasures and Suggestions are put forward to strengthen the prevention of major accidents from the responsibility implementation, risk prevention, science and technology, and so on.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Vehicle Infrastructure Cooperative System Based on 5G Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Intelligent vehicle-infrastructure cooperative system plays an increasingly greater role in the intelligent traffic system, this paper designs an intelligent vehicle-infrastructure cooperative system based on 5G mobile edge computing in order to improve the network latency of data transmission and asymmetric cryptographic algorithm was used to ensure the security of data. The system consists of four function modules: road side unit, on board unit, mobile edge computing equipment, central cloud platform, to realize the fusion processing of vehicle-road-edge-central cloud four-level data. The adaptive cruise model based on safe time distance of self-driving vehicle was used to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the system. Compared with the 4G vehicle-infrastructure cooperative system, the data transmission delay is reduced by 60% to 80%. Thus the short delay, high reliability and high speed vehicle-infrastructure cooperative system are realized, and provides a useful reference for the design and development of an efficient, safe and environmentally friendly intelligent traffic system.

articleTitle: Pedestrian and vehicle detection via port surveillance video
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In view of the diversity and complexity of the landscape environment and spatial layout of the port, the behaviors of relevant personnel and vehicles are relatively hidden, which leads to the problem that they can't be accurately identified in the surveillance video. In this paper, we used an improved object detection algorithm for personnel and vehicles applied in port environment, which combines the feature pyramid networks for feature extraction based on ResNet-101 and Faster R-CNN object detection network. The experimental results show that the algorithm has good real-time performance, and effectively improves the accuracy of related personnel and vehicle location detection and recognition in the port environment.

articleTitle: Pedestrian time-to-arrival judgment of vehicles in naturalistic traffic scenes
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Pedestrians' time-to-arrival (TTA) judgement is their estimation of the time taken by a vehicle to reach their position, which is an important and fallible process while making road-crossing decisions. Unlike most studies that were conducted in simulated settings, this study evaluated the accuracy of pedestrian's TTA judgement and how it is affected by vehicle size in real traffic scenarios with the classic prediction motion task. An analysis with linear mixed models showed a significant underestimation of pedestrians' TTA judgement, with slightly higher TTA estimation for larger vehicles. However, the vehicle size effect is scarcely significant (if it existed at all). These findings have implications on the safety intervention of pedestrians and mechanism of TTA judgment, and point to the need to ensure ecological validity in future research.

articleTitle: Analysis on Influencing Factors of accidents at national and provincial road intersections based on random forest
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In order to study the influencing factors of different accident injury degree at the intersections of national and provincial roads, the random forest model is used to predict the accident injury degree at intersections of national and provincial roads, and the model fusion method is used to improve its accuracy. The results show that the main factors affecting fatal accidents are accident form (pedestrian scratch), cause of accident (failing to give way and speeding), time period (early morning and evening), vehicle type (car and heavy truck), traffic control mode (no control, only signs and markings). On this basis, the improvement suggestions are put forward according to the factors affecting the accident. The research conclusions can provide decision-making reference for the accident prevention of national and provincial road intersections.

Author Keywords: accidents at national and provincial road intersections

articleTitle: Navigation Situation Adaptive Learning-Based Path Planning of Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In this paper, a navigation situation adaptive learning-based path planning (NSAL-PP) scheme is created for a maritime autonomous surface ships (MASS) with a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning (HDRL) algorithm. In the first level of hierarchy, the MASS navigational situation is adaptively learnt from the ontology theory and the Protégé logical language in terms of entities and attributes. In the second level of hierarchy, path planning skills are learnt by combining with deep Q-learning, the environment model, ship behavior space, reward function and exploration and utilization strategy. Specifically, the reward function consists of safety and navigational task. Finally, the simulations are built in the Python and 2D-Pygame platform, with Tianjin Port of China as a case study. Both simulation and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed NSAL-PP method is feasible and the collision free navigation is achieved, especially for narrow channel (waterway).

articleTitle: Study on site selection model of emergency rescue base based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: The site selection of emergency rescue base plays an important role in dealing with traffic accidents along the Yangtze River waterway. Emergency rescue base is used to store emergency resources, and whether emergency resources can be transported to the accident point in time determines the efficiency of accident handling. Therefore, the location of the site determines the distance and coverage of emergency assistance. The site selection of emergency rescue base method of the Yangtze River waterway is different from the road site selection of emergency rescue base. There is no specific route for planning, and it is also affected by the natural and social environment. The characteristics of the accident rate of each section of the Yangtze River should be considered, so there are many uncertain constraints. In this paper, the site selection model of emergency rescue base based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process is constructed, and the target layer, criterion layer and scheme layer are established by analytic hierarchy process, and the priority relationship is established. The weight value of each factor in the target is calculated and evaluated This paper combines the objectivity of the analytic hierarchy process with the inclusivity of the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, and puts forward a new practical and reliable method for the optimal decision of the site selection of the emergency rescue base.

articleTitle: Car Following Behavior Analysis of Different Types of Vehicles on Ten Lane Expressway Based on Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In order to grasp the driving behavior characteristics of the traffic volume of ten Lane expressway, this paper will use the high-level surveillance video of Shenzhen Shuiguan expressway as the data source, extract the basic traffic flow characteristics data such as traffic volume, running speed, headway and lane change times of different models of general sections and weaving sections, and based on the road environment information such as geometric conditions and the lane composition of ten Lane expressway, cellular automata models considering different vehicle types are established to deeply explore the car following behavior characteristics of vehicle driving.

articleTitle: Research on Ship Relation Graph Analysis Driven by Multi-source Data
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In order to improve the application level of maritime supervision and maritime security data, This paper uses scientific knowledge graphs and big data analysis technology to integrate a large number of multi-source, heterogeneous, isolated maritime business and navigation service data for knowledge fusion and knowledge reasoning, and builds a multi-source data-driven ship relationship graph network to make ship data easier to be understood and processed by people and machines, and achieves more accurate and efficient maritime and navigation ship information intelligent retrieval, ship relationship portrait analysis, and visualization and other fusion applications, effectively improve the level of maritime data application and enhance the ability of maritime supervision and analysis decision-making for ship safety.

articleTitle: Visual analysis of green shipping knowledge graph based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Green shipping has been recognized as the main trend in the past several decades. A total number of 240 research articles associated with green shipping have been retrieved from databases of CNKI core journals and CSSCI over the time span of 2002–2020. Knowledge graphs are thus obtained through CiteSpace, based on which the general research achievements in China are summarized. The results show that the trend of green shipping research could be divided into three stages, named as slow start, rapid rise and stable development. Research highlights differ during these stages, among which Yangtze river economic belt, emission control area and green shipping have been noted as three major issues. The comprehensiveness of green shipping research is becoming even more prominent. Visual analysis of knowledge graphs (e.g. co-citation networks, path finder and time zone) indicates that the basic theoretical research and key technology applications should be strengthened by means of interdisciplinary integration. It is believed that the green shipping would provide strong support for the future development of comprehensive transportation system in China.

articleTitle: Research on Risk-Based Method for Safety Intelligence Decision in Airlines
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In order to collect data effectively in a targeted way and achieve safety intelligence goal, this study cooperated with Kunming airlines co., LTD to develop a risk-based assessment method around aircraft scratch from “Operation” and “Support” two aspects. The study designed the data-oriented assessment sheet which contained the key operational processes of all related departments of the airline. Through the presupposed frequency of inspection, the airline can not only use the assessment sheet to collect inspection data and carry on the analysis, but also implement effective safety performance management to make safety intelligence decision.

articleTitle: A spline-LSTM for Autonomous Truck Trajectory Prediction Based on Curve feature extraction
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Complementing the missing trajectory data in real time is of great significance for the safe driving of autonomous trucks. This paper introduced a spline based long short-term memory network (LSTM) to tackle the positioning signal loss issues by realizing the real-time trajectory prediction of autonomous truck. The cubic B-spline curve is used to fit the trajectory data to obtain control points series. The LSTM is then used to train with historical data. As a result, without relying on the physical information of the road network and the surrounding environment information of the truck, truck trajectory prediction in 1–3 seconds is realized. A case study is conducted based on simulation data. Compared with other common methods, the proposed spline-LSTM shows advantages in both convergence speed and prediction accuracy, and is more suitable for real-time analysis.

articleTitle: Development and application of a real-time early-warning system for ship navigation in the Yangtze River
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: This paper presents a real-time early-warning system for ship navigation in the Yangtze River. Shipping accidents are prone in the narrow waterways such as the Yangtze River. Therefore, this paper intends to develop a real-time early-warning system to promote the safety of waterborne transportation. This paper is divided into four parts: system design, system architecture, key technologies and application. The system is developed by Visual C++ and QT Creator, including S57 electronic river charts management, target ship management, black-spot water area early-warning, ship grounding early-warning and ship-bridge collision early-warning. This paper analyzes the influencing factors for navigational risk which are identified from the trajectory data of ship navigation and well represent the navigational risk in real-time. The scenario of ship passing through the Second N anjing Yangtze River Bridge is used to verify the developed system. The results show that the system can effectively assist the crews to make decisions before accident occur, make up for the lack of real-time risk warning and improve the safety of ship navigation.

articleTitle: Driving-response mechanism of waterway regulations in a complex braided channel
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: The meandering and branching channels frequently appear in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River, China. Various waterway regulations projects have been performed to provide favorable navigable conditions for inland water transport. Owing to the complex driving and response mechanisms, the relationship between regulation strategies and hydrodynamics has not yet been revealed. Thus, a case study is presented in Dongliu channel, characterized as a complex braided river. The relationship between river shaking force and geometry is evaluated in terms of channel and riverbed stability index. The results indicate that the waterway conditions are generally improved although a few negative variations have been observed at the inlet of Laohu Shoal and Xigang. In the light of hydrograph, the stability index of Dongliu channel is evaluated considering river bank protections, flow conditions and river configurations. Meanwhile, human activities would alter the river bathymetry and hydrodynamic conditions, thus should be carefully considered during developing a waterway regulation program. The present study could provide a guidance for waterway regulations in complex braided rivers.

articleTitle: Single ship target detection based on the concept of edge computing
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Target detection is an important research direction in the subject of computer vision, and it has a wide range of applications. Inland river ship target detection is of great significance to inland river environment detection, inland river ship obstacle avoidance, and other fields. However, as the requirements for the intelligence of ships become higher and higher, there will be more and more equipment on ships. These devices will rely on the computing power of the terminal computer to complete data processing and other related tasks. This will lead to problems such as excessive load on the terminal computer equipment and tight computing power. Therefore, this paper introduces the concept of edge computing on the basis of traditional target detection methods. We use edge devices with computing power to complete single target detection of moving ships. This will alleviate problems such as tight computing power of terminal computer equipment to a certain extent. Since the edge device is close to the edge side, the data transmission delay problem can also be optimized, which is of great significance to the development of smart ships.

articleTitle: Safety responsibility analysis of road transportation of driverless vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: The division of responsibility is a difficult problem faced by the application of driverless vehicles. According to the Law of the People's Republic of China on Road Traffic Safety and the Law of the People's Republic of China on W ork Safety, the actual controller of the vehicle is responsible for traffic violations, and the production and business operation entity shall be responsible for the main liability for the accident. Production and business units shall establish a new production safety responsibility system according to the new operation mode of driverless vehicles. Where there is a causal relationship between the vehicle and its parts, roads, management and third-party testing, the relevant units and individuals shall bear the corresponding liabilities according to law.

articleTitle: Robust Object Profile Extraction Based on Multi-beam Sonar
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Multi-beam sonar is one of the most important visual perception tools for underwater medium and longdistance object detection. The sonar image obtained by it is an important data source for Three-dimensional reconstruction of underwater scenes. In order to solve the problems of background noise and clutter in underwater target detection based on multi-beam sonar, a robust object profile extraction method for multi-beam image sonar is proposed in this paper. Firstly, threshold processing and non-maximum suppression are carried out for the points on each column of the image according to the pixel gray value to obtain the candidate points of the object profile. Secondly, according to the imaging principle of multi-beam sonar, the likelihood probability model of candidate points and the jump penalty model between adjacent columns of image are established to remove the influence of noise on profile extraction. According to the characteristics of the established objective function, the dynamic programming method is used to solve the problem. The experimental results of measured and simulated data show that this algorithm is simple and easy to operate, and can accurately and effectively extract the single profile of multi-beam image sonar, which has a high application value.

articleTitle: Risk prioritization in autonomous ship operational modes using FMEA and interval numbers
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: The Maritime Safety Committee of the International Maritime Organization named autonomous ships as Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships. For Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships, it is of utmost importance to remain at a required safety level, or acceptable risk, in ad hoc operational modes. Recently, the concept of risk has been increasingly adopted to measure the safety of socio-technical systems. In the case of Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships, a continuous risk assessment may be required, with respect to a predefined set of unwanted events associated with a corresponding operational modes. Despite the growing number of research works related to autonomous ships and their safety, an approach to compare the operating regimes from the point of risk assessment is still lacking in literature. Therefore, this paper proposes a three-step framework, aiming to assess the risk index and its uncertainty for a Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships in a given scenario, in three operational modes: Manual Control, Remote Control, and Autonomous Control. The applicability of the proposed framework is demonstrated on conventional ship grounding accidents, assuming the ships as being Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships. The results reveal that in a same scenario, the risk of Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships grounding and the inherent uncertainty vary across the operational modes.

articleTitle: Knowledge Base Construction Of Ship Energy Efficiency Accounting For Various Environmental Factors Based On Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Nowadays, energy saving and emission reduction have aroused widespread concern in the maritime industry. Energy efficiency optimization is one of the effective ways to save energy and reduce emissions. Ship energy efficiency is synthetically influenced by multiple factors including environmental and operational profile. The randomness of these factors results in very complex interrelation among the environment and ship engine speed as well as ship energy efficiency. It is difficult for the semi-empirical or theoretical modeling methods to describe such interrelation accurately. The rapid development of big data analysis makes it possible to obtain the association rules of various environmental factors and ship energy efficiency as well as engine speed. In this paper, big data analyses in terms of Parallel Distributed K-Means Clustering (PDKC) algorithm and Parallel Frequent Pattern Mining (PFPM) algorithm are adopted to achieve the clustering analysis of ship energy efficiency related data, and to obtain the interrelation among ship energy efficiency and environmental factors as well as engine speed. On this basis, the knowledge base of ship energy efficiency accounting for various environmental factors is established. The constructed knowledge base can be used for exploring optimization methods of ship energy efficiency, promoting decision-making system development and contributing to energy saving and emission reduction of ships.

articleTitle: Research on Traffic Information Extraction Approach Based on Image Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning methods in the field of computer vision, the effective methods can be applied to the classification and positioning of traffic targets based on real traffic data. This paper studies the application of convolutional neural network in the real traffic information extraction field. The YOLOv3 target detection algorithm, the Faster RCNN target detection algorithm and the SSD target detection algorithm are used to detect vehicles in the images collected in same road condition, and generate the result graph of the target detection. The experimental results show that the YOLOv3 target detection algorithm, Faster RCNN target detection algorithm and SSD target detection algorithm can identify all traffic targets in the traffic road images. It reveals the three algorithms meet the detection needs, and help to achieve non-contact traffic flow collection and feature recognition. Meanwhile these algorithms can provide technical means for traffic supervision and safety improvement.

articleTitle: Ranking Analysis of Highway Accident Impact Factors Based on Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Road traffic accidents occur frequently recent years. To improve the driving safety of drivers, traffic accident analysis attracts road safety management agencies to investigate what lead to accidents and how to prevent them. In this paper, the impact factors of traffic accidents were analyzed and ranked by using field data of the year of 2012 in California from the Highway Safety Information System (HSIS) dataset. Accident severity was taken as the dependent variable; and thirteen indexes, which are related to environment, roads and drivers, were selected as impact factors respectively. Firstly, the dataset of the accident causation analysis was established after data cleaning. Secondly, support vector machine-recursive feature elimination (SVC-RFE) and random forest-recursive feature elimination algorithm (RF -RFE) were used to rank the importance of indicators. After triple cross validation, the optimal number of features of the two algorithms is obtained. The results show that the rankings obtained by the two methods are similar whether the accident severity or the degree of casualties are the dependent variables. For RF -RFE with high cross-validation scores, the similarity rate can reach 66.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. The results of this paper can lead to traffic accident analysis methods and can guide effective prevention measures.

articleTitle: The Influence Path of Safety Culture on Pilot's Safety Behavior
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Compared with other industries, consequence caused by unsafe behavior of pilots are more serious. Tremendous effort is required to strive towards zero accidents. In order to explore the influence of pilot situation safety culture on pilots' safety behavior and highlight the importance of pilot safety culture construction, relevant research scale is developed to conduct a survey on pilot nationwide. Sample data are obtained from pilot stations nationwide, with 272 valid collected results. After validity and reliability test of the sample data, structural equation model is performed to analyze the relationship between safety culture, safety attitude, safety cognition and pilot safety behavior. The result show that safety culture has a positive impact on pilot's safety behavior; safety attitude and safety cognition have a significant mediating effect between safety culture and safety behavior.

articleTitle: A Methodology to Evaluate the Safety Prevention and Control System Effectiveness for a Ship Underway
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Considering the problems of scene variability and time sequence degradation from safety prevention and control system effectiveness for a ship underway, a new methodology based on degradation characteristic parameter analysis and effectiveness degradation evaluation is proposed. First, the numerical polarization technique is introduced to normalize the degradation characteristic parameters to realize the dimensionless transformation between the indices and the difference convergence within the domain. Second, a quasinormal distribution of statistical parameters is used to solve the ideal value of the degradation characteristic parameter at a certain time point, to process the fluctuation error of multiple scene characteristics. Third, a Weibull distribution based on degradation analysis theory is used to solve the change trend of degradation characteristic parameters in a time series to achieve the dynamic evaluation of prevention and control effectiveness degradation. Finally, the methodology is evaluated on testing ships, and the results show that the accuracy of evaluation can be effectively improved. Compared with the traditional static evaluation methods, the proposed methodology in this paper is closer to the actual situation, and the dynamic characteristics of the safety prevention and control system can be comprehensively considered in the evaluation process.

articleTitle: Research on Speed Optimization of Inland Vessels Based on a Shuffled Frog-leaping Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Improving the efficiency of energy utilization and reducing greenhouse gas emissions is a hot issue in the field of shipping. For inland vessels, speed optimization is an important method for energy efficiency improvement. Different from seagoing ships, the navigation environment has an important influence on the ship resistance when building the prediction model of main engine fuel consumption. The main influencing factors are channel depth, channel cross-sectional area, and wind speed. In this paper, considered the influence of various navigation environment factors, and combined with the Holtrop-Mennen method, a prediction model of inland vessel resistance has been established. Based on this model, combined with the ship-engine-propeller matching and the power-fuel consumption curve of the main engine, the prediction model of the main engine fuel consumption is established. The shuffled frog-leaping algorithm is used to optimize the speed with the minimum fuel consumption of a single voyage as the objective with constraints of the engine speed, ship speed, and total sailing time. Then, the route is divided into several segments based on geographical region. The simulation results show that the ship speed optimization is effective.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Heat Transfer Characteristics on PCHE Precooler in the Brayton Cycle for Supercritical CO2 Waste Heat Recovery
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Energy saving and emission reduction is the main theme of the development of present shipbuilding industry, and the recovery of flue gas waste heat is a promising direction. The supercritical CO2 (SCO2) Brayton cycle power generation system is used to realize waste heat recovery based on its high efficiency and compact characteristics. Compared with the traditional heat exchanger, the printed circuit heat exchanger (PC HE) has the advantages of high efficiency, high temperature resistance and high pressure resistance, so it is used in SCO2 Brayton cycle power generation system. In this paper, a SCO2 Brayton cycle test platform was built, and a large number of heat transfer characteristic tests were done to verify the reliability of the PCHE test piece of this platform. The study found that within the range of working conditions studied, the friction coefficient of SCO2 decreases with the increase of its Re, and the Nu of SCO2 increases with the increase of its Re. By comparing the experimental values with the traditional friction coefficient correlation and heat transfer correlation, it is found that these empirical formulas cannot accurately predict the thermal-hydraulic characteristics of SCO2 in PCHE; in addition, studies have shown that the increase in the temperature difference on the hot side can increase the minimum heat exchanger effectiveness. This research provides support for the subsequent experimental research of SCO2 in the Brayton cycle power generation system.

articleTitle: Vessel traffic flow simulation: Application of Monte-Carlo method and RS analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In the past several decades, the water transport experiences a fast growing and contributes effectively to the social-economic developments in China. The maritime traffic situation becomes even more complicated due to the dense vessel traffic flow. Based on the massive historical AIS data, characteristics of inland vessel traffic flow are explored. Monte Carlo method has been adopted and a novel model for vessel traffic flow simulation is thus proposed. A case study is performed in the middle reaches of Y angtze River, China. The comparison between simulations and field observations are general favorable. Furthermore, rescaled range analysis has been performed to reveal fractal features of inland vessel traffic flow. Based on R/S analysis method, the Hurst index is calculated as 0.7386 which indicates that vessel traffic flow owns fractal features. The RMSE of fractal prediction is approximately 9.20. The historical traffic flow information is thus utilized to reveal future tendency of traffic flow. The conclusions are consistent with the previous studies. The Monte Carlo based vessel traffic flow model would be further applied to waterway capacity evaluations in future.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Prediction

articleTitle: Linking personal norms and descriptive norms to pedestrians' intention to jaywalk: the mediating role of anticipated regret and risk perception
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Pedestrians have been involved in approximately one-third of traffic accidents in China. As important social contextual factors, social norms play important roles in predicting unsafe behaviors among pedestrians. Based on the focus theory of normative conduct and self-construal, the current study aims to explore the mediating role of anticipated regret and risk perception in the relationship between two norms (personal and descriptive) and pedestrians' intention to jaywalk, as well as the moderating role of self-construal. A total of 409 adult pedestrians participated in our questionnaire survey, with 342 valid data collected. Results showed that both personal and descriptive norms significantly predicted pedestrians' intention to jaywalk. Anticipated regret (emotional path) and risk perception (cognitive path) had significant mediating effects. Specifically, the more negative the personal norms, the lower the pedestrians' anticipated regret, and the higher the intention to violate the traffic rules. The more negative the descriptive norms, the lower the pedestrians' risk perception, and the higher the intention to violate the traffic rules. In addition, self-construal moderated the aforementioned relationship. Specifically, for pedestrians who were higher on independent self-construal, personal norms had a stronger effect on intention through anticipated regret. For pedestrians who were higher on interdependent self-construal, descriptive norms had a stronger effect on the intention through the anticipated regret and risk perception. Finally, the contributions of the current study to pedestrian safety interventions are discussed.

articleTitle: The Channel Depth Maintenance Research in the Middle Reaches of Yangtze River Based on the Cost-effectiveness Balance
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Channel dredging is an important means to ensure the safe navigation of ships. Besides the maximizing channel capacity, many factors should be taken into account in channel depth including the dredging operation cost. At present, the channel depth maintenances are mostly formulated according to experience and relating standards, so the abundant dredging depth results in much invalid maintenance operations. Through the factors affecting ship draft, shallow waterway effects, risk theory and channel maintenance costs, we constructed a stochastic possibility simulation model to simulate the channel depth and probability of ship grounding in the middle reaches of Yangtze River based on Monte Carlo method. In this paper, we present an optimal depth calculating model on the cost-effectiveness balance of channel dredging maintenance. The method has high practicability for port channel maintenance and management and can provide a theoretical basis for the follow-up research.

articleTitle: The “Port Shuttle Hub System” Model based on Rail-Sea Intermodal Transportation Taking Shenzhen Port as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: The major ports along the coast of China that undertake container transportation are all facing problems in collection and dispatching to a certain extent. In particular, due to the recent impact of the COVID-19 epidemic, truck drivers have difficulty moving across regions, and there was once a phenomenon of no containers being transported by vehicles. This paper sorted out the basic situation of container port collection and dispatching methods all over the world. Taking Shenzhen Port as an example, this paper focused on the analysis of the structural characteristics of container transportation and the impact on the rear urban traffic and atmospheric environment. Then it proposed a intermodal transportation network and established the “Port Shuttle Hub System” model, which would closely link the port with the railway and inland port, and integrate the transportation organization mode, which greatly improves the efficiency of port containers' transportation.

articleTitle: A Scobit-Based Car-sharing Participation Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: A Scobit-based model, which considers individual heterogeneity, is proposed to analyze the residents' willingness to participate in car-sharing programs. In the Scobit model, skewness parameters are used to reflect the heterogeneity of individual attributes of different travelers. During the parameter calibration and elasticity analysis progress, the model is mutually validated with the results of Binary Logit model. It shows that the Binary Logit model and Scobit model are consistent with the calibration results and Scobit model performs better than Binary Logit model. Based on the results, the factors of age, occupation, household income, car hailing and car rental experience, vehicle cost, vehicle mileage, parking service, vehicle type and vehicle return method significantly affect people's choices. Besides, elastic value analysis results show that vehicle costs, vehicle's mileage, parking services have greater impact on the choice of residents than others. Finally, some advice is given to encourage the car-sharing participation willingness.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Demonstration Operation for Fuel Cell Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: China has continued to support the development of hydrogen energy and fuel cell vehicle technology through National Science and Technology projects, and carried out demonstrations and applications of hydrogen energy and fuel cells continuously. Relevant departments have cooperated to carry out a series ofprojects to promote the commercial development offuel cell vehicles in China, enabling our country to achieve leapfrog development in terms of the durability, performance, and costs of fuel cell vehicles, and to promote fuel cell vehicles on a large scale. This article is based on the relevant data collected from the National Monitoring and Management Center for New Energy Vehicles, which is China's national big data platform for EVs. Conducting detailed statistics and analysis of the market size and operation conditions offuel cell vehicles nationwide, and select the typical city, compare and analyze the operating characteristics of fuel cell vehicles and pure electric vehicles from multiple angles. Providing a solid data supportfor the large-scale promotion offuel cell vehicles, and promoting the commercial development of fuel cell vehicles in China.

articleTitle: Velocity Optimization of Connected Electric Vehicle at Multiple Signalized Intersections for Energy Efficiency and Traffic Throughput Improvement
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Signalized intersection can interrupt the traffic flow, potentially increasing vehicle energy consumption levels and extending travel time. This paper presents an eco-approach and departure strategy (EAD) using a double-layer control scheme, to achieve the optimization of energy economy and traffic throughput for connected electric vehicle (EV) at the route with multiple intersections and varying road slopes. In the first layer, for improving traffic throughput, we design a traffic light green window planning method with consideration of the spatio-temporal coupling of intersections. Then, in the second layer, a distance-domain optimal control problem (OCP) is formulated considering the intersection segment, green window intervals, and speed limitations. This OCP is solved by dynamic programming algorithm, to derive the energy-optimal speed. Finally, a simulation is conducted using the route from a real-world scenario in Nanjing, China, to evaluate the performance of the proposed strategy. The results indicate the proposed EAD strategy can improve EV energy efficiency and traffic throughput dramatically compared with the regular constant speed strategy.

articleTitle: Kinodynamic Motion Planning for Autonomous Surface Ships Using Motion Primitives
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In this letter, a method of kinodynamic-feasible trajectory planning for autonomous surface ships is proposed. By sampling in the control space, the discrete control inputs are obtained. Then, under the conditions of the control inputs obtained, forward integrate the system equation of the ship over a given short time to obtain the motion primitives. optimal trajectories by exploring the map using a set of short-time motion primitives. Using a series of motion primitives to construct a state lattice graph in the state space, that can be explored using graph search algorithms. The proposed method can generate smooth trajectories under the dynamics and kinematics of the ship's system, which creates favorable conditions for subsequent motion control and trajectory tracking.

articleTitle: Study on the Implementation Path of Peaking Carbon Emissions in Container Terminals
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: In order to implement China's carbon emissions peak strategy and accelerate the promotion of reaching carbon emissions peak in container terminals, this study uses container terminals as the object, accounts current direct carbon emissions in Chinese container terminals through investigating typical terminals; compares and analyzes the main carbon emission reduction measures from the perspectives of technical level, investment cost, and others; on this basis, construct the predictive model of direct carbon emissions, and uses scenario analysis to carry out carbon emission predictions under each scenario and analyzes the effect of policy intervention, technological development and other factors on carbon emission peak. According to the predictive results, this study holds that in order to achieve direct carbon emission peak in container terminals as soon as possible, container terminals should strongly promote the application of clean energy to port machinery instead of fuel on the basis of the industrial development and cost reduction of high-power and large-capacity power batteries, actively adopt high-efficiency and low-carbon fuel equipment, and vigorously promote the production efficiency of fuel machinery; at the same time, strengthen policy encouragement and guidance are needed.

Author Keywords: application of clean energy in Container Terminals

articleTitle: Research on mass and road slope estimation algorithm for truck based on DRLSM
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Real-time and high-precision estimation of vehicle mass and road slope information is crucial to improve vehicle control performance and driving safety. In view of this, a parallel algorithm with forgetting factor based on Double Recursive Least Squares Method (DRLSM) is proposed. In this method, two estimators run simultaneously. One estimates the mass and the other calculate the road slope. After setting different road gradients and different loading in the Trucksim/Simulink co-simulation, results show that the algorithm has fast convergence and good tracking accuracy.

Author Keywords: dual Recursive least square with forgetting factor

articleTitle: Navigation safety simulation and optimization strategy of LNG ships in Yangtze River Estuary Channel
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: The Yangtze River Estuary Channel is the throat of the Yangtze River golden waterway, which plays an irreplaceable role in the development of the Yangtze River economic belt. With the rapid growth of China's LNG consumption demand and foreign trade import demand, the demand for LNG transportation in the Yangtze River is becoming more and more urgent. At present, the Yangtze River waterway is not suitable for LNG transportation, but it has great potential for LNG transportation in the future. Firstly, this paper analyzes and forecasts the potential LNG water transportation demand and ship flow in the Yangtze River Estuary Channel; secondly, using the simulation modeling technology, it analyzes the impact of different ship flow scenarios on the existing navigation channels such as the 12.5m deep water channel of the Yangtze River Estuary and the south passage channel of the Yangtze River Estuary under the scenario of allowing LNG ships to enter and leave the Yangtze River Estuary Channel; finally, according to the simulation, it proposes to take countermeasures for LNG ships in the Yangtze River Estuary Channel.

articleTitle: Analysis of Application Potential of Hydrogen Energy in Low Carbon Transformation of Waterborne Traffic
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: Waterborne transportation is an important pivot of comprehensive stereoscopic transportation. As China is formulating an action plan for peaking carbon dioxide emission before 2030, the green and low carbon transformation of waterway transportation is facing great pressure. As a new energy carrier, hydrogen energy is regarded as an important pathway to realize the low carbon transformation in the fields of ports and ships. This paper reviews the application of hydrogen energy in ports and ships. Based on the existing data, it is inferred that the application of hydrogen fuel in ports, ships and heavy-duty truck sector can reduce CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission by 10.12 million tons in China. Finally, suggestions on the application of hydrogen energy in waterway transportation sector are put forward.

articleTitle: A Method to Analyze Decay Pattern of Near-Field Evanescent Wave in Finite length Cylindrical Shell
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
abstract: An approach is proposed in this paper to analysis the decay characteristic of near field evanescent waves from a finite cylindrical shell. Firstly, the wave-number spectrum method is used to obtain the component of main vibration mode. Then the evanescent wave theory for infinite cylindrical shell is adopted to approximately analyze the decay characteristic of near field evanescent waves from the finite cylindrical shell. Based on the analysis results for evanescent waves, the interface between the near field and far field and the position of artificial boundary of numerical methods can be determined. In the end, comparison of numerical results between the FE-IE method and FE-BE method shows the validation of the approach for analysis the decay characteristic of near field evanescent waves. The proposed method can be used to evaluate the decay characteristic of near field evanescent waves from finite cylindrical shell structures and simple shape of ducts.

articleTitle: Investigation on Parameters Influence Rules of a Hovercraft Air Propeller
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Transportation Information and Safety (ICTIS)
